canonicalization_paths.notes: Strict DAG-JSON for identity; finite floats allowed; ensure_ascii=False; rejects NaN/infinity and default=repr objects. Legacy canonical_json_bytes retains default=repr and is not the identity path.
Same strict DAG-JSON split as accelerate. cid_for_obj uses legacy canonical_json_bytes with raw codec; cid_for_dag_json uses strict bytes with dag-json codec.
Rejects floats, bytes, sets, paths, and repr fallback. Must not be silently equated with cid_utils finite-float DAG-JSON.
ir-canonical-json-v1: Unicode NFC, Decimal numbers, set/multiset collection rules, raw multicodec identity. Explicitly not the dag-json supervisor profile.

Profile D DAG-JSON uses ensure_ascii=True; ASCII payloads can match kit/accelerate raw JSON, unicode payloads must not be silently equated. Requires the multiformats package; absence is a typed capability gap, not a second CID system.

Profile G rejects floats and integers outside the JSON safe range, then emits ensure_ascii=False compact JSON. Must not be silently equated with cid_utils finite-float DAG-JSON or Profile D ensure_ascii=True bytes.
NFD/whitespace axiom and theorem normalization plus SHA-256 of canonical text. Not a CID profile and not a content-seal canonicalizer.
ensure_ascii=True compact JSON for Kubo-raw artifact CIDs. Unicode encoding differs from accelerate/datasets cid_utils (ensure_ascii=False).
ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False compact JSON. Default CID codec is dag-json, not raw.
Proof-reuse store/load boundary re-canonicalizes retained DAG-JSON bytes and refuses non-canonical retained bytes.

Signed runner attestations use strict DAG-CBOR, not DAG-JSON. Codec mixing is a profile contradiction, not equivalence. Independent validator must judge dag_cbor and multiformats against the sealed PATH; absence is a typed capability gap.

cid_paths.notes: Dependency-free CIDv1/base32/sha2-256 for codecs raw and dag-json. External multiformats is only used outside the closed profile.
Supervisor identity bridge. Rejects ambiguous str/path/file input. Links local content_identity and runtime-artifact:sha256 IDs without replacing them.

ContentIdentity@1 bridge reuses datasets canonicalizers. Cross-profile equality is never inferred from matching payloads or digests; differences are typed profile contradictions. Missing multiformats fails closed for CID-required operations. Digest-shaped strings are never labeled as CIDs.
FACP-026 replacement of MockIPFSMultiformats hex-as-CID. Pseudo hex/Qm forms are integrity.unchecked, not CIDs.
Kubo-compatible raw CIDv1 helper used by cross-package tests.
Not dependency-free. Independent validator must judge multiformats availability against the sealed PATH. Absence is a typed capability gap, not a second CID system.
Sole owner of software-contract CID profile v1. Source bytes use raw; structured artifacts use dag-json. Decode-and-recompute is mandatory on read.
ir-canonical-identity-v1 assembles CIDv1/raw/sha2-256/base32 without consulting CID packages.
Kubo-conformant raw artifact CID. Default for MCP++ receipts/intents.
Default codec dag-json. Recomputed CID is required on store/load. Not a second CID system; same wire profile, different default codec from artifacts.py.
Historical get_cid helpers, including MockIPFSMultiformats SHA-256 hex labeled as CID. Inventoried by FACP-026. Not production CID authority.

sha_paths.notes: Closed-profile CID hashes exact payload bytes with hashlib.sha256 then wraps the digest. cid_from_sha256_digest wraps an already-computed digest without hashing again.
Git blob OID binds absence/oversized structured identity; available bytes receive a raw source CID. Git OID is not a CID and is not a full-stream substitute.

Reads file chunks into one hashlib.sha256. This is still one stream digest, not a composition of independent chunk hashes. Historical get_cid helpers that wrap this digest as a hex or Qm label remain legacy_non_authority.
Kubo-raw artifact CID hashes canonicalize_artifact JSON bytes with one hashlib.sha256, then wraps CIDv1/raw. Same one-stream digest rule.
Coordination CID hashes _canonical_json bytes with one hashlib.sha256. Default codec is dag-json.
